title: Deterministic, Reproducible Inference in Exact Integer Arithmetic, and Verifiable Distributed Inference as Its Consequence
abstract: arXiv:2611.13730v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Optimized floating-point inference is not reproducible across environments: the same model on different hardware, compilers or thread counts can produce different bits. We present tritify, an open-source runtime that executes the forward pass of real models -- decoder-only language models, Mixture-of-Experts decoders, and the Segment Anything 2.1 image/video stack -- with the entire run-time path in exact integer arithmetic; floating point is confined to offline quantization and the float reference used for verification. We make three separate claims and verify each. (1) Cross-hardware reproducibility: the integer path produces bit-identical output run to run, across CPU instruction-set architectures, and across CPU/GPU, carried by a reproducing SHA-256 of the output. (2) Decision fidelity: the integer path reproduces the float reference's decision on the models and inputs tested, with the numeric exceptions measured; per-layer fidelity

translated_title: 精确整数运算下的确定性、可复现推理，以及由此实现的可验证分布式推理
translated_abstract: 优化后的浮点推理在不同环境中不可复现：同一模型在不同的硬件、编译器或线程数下可能产生不同的比特结果。我们提出了 tritify，一个开源运行时系统，它以精确整数运算执行真实模型——包括仅解码器语言模型、混合专家解码器以及 Segment Anything 2.1 图像/视频处理栈——的前向传播，整个运行时路径均采用精确整数运算；浮点运算仅限于离线量化以及用于验证的浮点参考。我们提出三个相互独立的声明并逐一验证。(1) 跨硬件可复现性：整数路径在多次运行之间、跨不同 CPU 指令集架构以及跨 CPU/GPU 均产生比特级完全相同的输出，并由输出结果的 SHA-256 哈希值来承载该可复现性验证。(2) 决策保真度：整数路径在所测试的模型和输入上复现了浮点参考的决策结果，并对数值异常情况进行了测量；逐层保真度……
tldr: 该论文提出开源运行时 tritify，将真实模型推理的整个运行时路径置于精确整数运算中，实现了跨硬件、跨平台的比特级可复现推理，并以此为基础支持可验证的分布式推理。
en_tdlr: tritify is an open-source runtime that executes the entire inference path of real models in exact integer arithmetic, achieving bit-identical cross-hardware reproducibility and thereby enabling verifiable distributed inference.
